properties.findings: Observed FAILING FIRST on a clean origin/main 3a14696 build under the shared build lock: 18 of 117 served write tools wrote an AUTHORED_BY naming another contributor for a caller the gateway named (acknowledge_defect, acknowledge_gap, acknowledge_gaps, add_decision, add_design_rule, add_requirement, apply_merge, authored_by, collapse_decision, create_edge, create_edges, create_node, create_nodes, delete_edge, draw_edges, import_graph, set_decision_status, set_requirement_status), and an undeclared registry wrote all five settling calls. Passing on the fix, with every refused call leaving the design exactly as it was. The core test (crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_signature_is_the_callers_own_where_it_is_written.rs) is new with the Signer API it checks, so it could not run on main; it passes.
properties.name: On an engine served for others every served write tool writes only the caller's own signature: each of the write tools read off the served surface is driven through a real registry as the caller and again in another contributor's name, bulk and nested items included; nothing signs or settles where nobody is established; the store's write points hold it
